subject: MAP Weekly: data deployment choices, retention & PII action log
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Lim <sarah.lim@acme-corp.com>; Paul Ng <paul.ng@acme-corp.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 20 Jun 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: MAP Weekly: data deployment choices, retention & PII action log

Hi Sarah / Paul —

Quick weekly checkpoint from the MAP side on the deployment & data handling items we promised for next milestone. TL;DR: we can support VPC peering and an on-prem option for the pilot, but Acme needs to decide retention windows for logs and confirm PII scope by next Friday.

Notes from today's internal sync:
- VPC/on-prem: Redwood Private (VPC) supports peering + customer-managed NAT. On-prem option requires our air-gapped installer and a short security review. Marcus to confirm exact sizing.
- Retention: default proposal is 30 days for inference logs, 90 days for audit logs — configurable.
- PII: we flagged token-level retention vs. ephemeral caching; need Acme to confirm whether credit-card tokens or user IDs must be redacted at source.

Action items (owners & target dates):
1) Marcus: produce a short VPC architecture diagram with expected CIDR ranges and egress controls — due Wed 24 Jun.
2) Neha: draft a minimal SOC2 evidence pack extract and list of artifacts we'd provide — due Thu 25 Jun.
3) Acme (Sarah): confirm PII sensitive fields list and desired retention policy (30/90/custom) — due Fri 26 Jun.
4) Marissa: update MAP spreadsheet with the above items + gating criteria for go/no-go — due Fri 26 Jun.

Attachments: ACME_MAP_v3.xlsx, redwood-vpc-architecture-diagram.pdf (placeholder)

If any of the owners see a blocker, please flag in-thread so we can loop in Legal or Platform Security.

Thanks —

Kimberly Park
Sr. Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0198
--
Redwood Inference — Production-first inference runtime
From: Acme Security <acme-security@acme-corp.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sarah Lim <sarah.lim@acme-corp.com>; Paul Ng <paul.ng@acme-corp.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Jun 2026 11:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP Weekly: data deployment choices, retention & PII action log

Kimberly —

Thanks for the update. A couple clarifying questions from our side:
1) For the 30-day inference log retention, can we configure per-environment (staging vs prod)? We prefer shorter retention in staging.
2) Will Redwood's prefix/KV caching ever persist raw request payloads to disk on the host? If so, what encryption is applied and how do we control keys?
3) For the on-prem installer, we need a list of 3rd-party OSS components and versions for our SBOM.

A few asks:
- Please provide an export with the PII class markers (PII types + examples) so our data classification team can map to our schema.
- We will schedule a security call if the installer requires elevated host privileges.

Best,
Acme Security (on behalf of Paul Ng)
acme-security@acme-corp.com

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>

Date: Wed, 24 Jun 2026 08:37:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP Weekly: data deployment choices, retention & PII action log

Folks —

Quick status update after syncing with Platform Security and Product Ops:
- SOC2 evidence: I can assemble a minimal extract (system descriptions, access control screenshots, rotation policy excerpt). Will attach a 1-pager. ETA Thu EOD (25 Jun).
- Keys/KMS: default is customer-managed KMS (AWS KMS or GCP KMS). We'll provide instructions for key rotation and an option to bring your own HSM in Private deployments.
- Caching: runtime keeps KV cache in memory; we do not persist request payloads to disk by default. For longer-term debug logs we persist aggregates and redacted request metadata — those are encrypted at rest.

Open questions we should confirm with Acme in the call:
- Per-environment retention (staging 7d, prod 30d?)
- Whether certain PII classes (SSN, CC numbers) should be redacted in transit vs at ingestion.

I'll attach the SOC2 extract and a short SBOM checklist for the installer. Marcus — can you confirm the CIDR ranges by EOD Wed? I will then update the MAP spreadsheet.

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Security & Compliance, Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.ai
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Lim <sarah.lim@acme-corp.com>, Paul Ng <paul.ng@acme-corp.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 26 Jun 2026 16:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP Weekly: data deployment choices, retention & PII action log

Sarah / Paul —

Thanks for the quick responses this week. Summary and next steps below (finalizing before the executive review next Tue):

Summary of agreements so far:
- Deployment mode: Acme agreed to proceed with Redwood Private (VPC peering) for pilot. On-prem installer remains on the table if the security review requires it.
- Retention: Acme requested per-environment policy. Proposed: staging=7 days (inference logs), prod=30 days (inference logs); audit logs 90 days.
- PII handling: Acme will provide the PII list by 26 Jun. We built two blocking rules: immediate redaction at ingestion for CC/SSN, and token obfuscation option for user IDs.

Final action items (owners):
- Marcus Lin (Redwood): final VPC diagram + CIDR ranges + expected throughput numbers — due Mon 29 Jun.
- Neha Kapoor (Redwood): SOC2 extract, SBOM checklist, KMS instructions — delivered (attached).
- Acme Security (Paul / Sarah): final PII list and sign-off on per-environment retention — due Mon 29 Jun.
- Marissa Cole (Redwood Sales Ops): update MAP spreadsheet and schedule exec review slot with Acme — due Mon 29 Jun.

Attachments delivered: data-retention-table.csv, ACME_MAP_v3.xlsx (updated rows), redwood-vpc-architecture-diagram.pdf

If Acme confirms PII list and retention by Mon morning we will push the MAP into the exec review path and scope the pilot deployment window (tentative start 2 Jul).

Thanks everyone —

Kimberly Park
Sr. Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0198
